mapper.select: SELECT claim_day, claims, opened, pending_open FROM pet_card_player WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT command FROM pet_card_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_card_operation (user_id, request_id, command) VALUES (#{userId}, #{requestId}, #{command})
mapper.select: SELECT pool_id, quantity, opened FROM pet_card_stock WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pool_id
SELECT pool_id, quantity, opened FROM pet_card_stock WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pool_id = #{pool}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_card_stock (user_id, pool_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{pool}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{quantity}
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_card_player SET claim_day = #{day}, claims = #{claims} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_card_opening (user_id, pool_id, pool_name, opened_at, cards) VALUES (#{userId}, #{opening.poolId}, #{opening.poolName}, #{opening.openedAt}, #{opening.cards})
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_card_stock SET quantity = quantity - #{quantity}, opened = opened + #{quantity} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pool_id = #{pool}
UPDATE pet_card_player SET pending_open = #{pending}, opened = opened + #{quantity} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE pet_card_player SET pending_open = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pet_card_collection WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY card_id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.grade, o.stars, c.art_key, c.art_tile, a.portrait, c.stats, c.battle FROM pet_card_collection o JOIN pet_card_definition c ON c.id = o.card_id JOIN pet_card_atlas a ON a.id = c.art_key WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.showcased = TRUE ORDER BY o.card_id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.grade, o.stars, c.art_key, c.art_tile, a.portrait FROM pet_card_collection o JOIN pet_card_definition c ON c.id = o.card_id JOIN pet_card_atlas a ON a.id = c.art_key WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE c.grade WHEN 'shiny' THEN 1 WHEN 'legendary' THEN 2 WHEN 'epic' THEN 3 WHEN 'fine' THEN 4 WHEN 'common' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, o.card_id LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_card_collection WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM pet_card_collection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND card_id = #{card}
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_card_collection SET duplicates = duplicates + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND card_id = #{card}
UPDATE pet_card_collection SET stars = #{stars}, duplicates = duplicates - #{cost} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND card_id = #{card}
UPDATE pet_card_collection SET showcased = #{displayed} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND card_id = #{card}
UPDATE pet_card_collection SET showcased = FALSE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND showcased = TRUE
